Name: Admin approves account — all conditions met (DT Rule 1: Y/Y/Y → APPROVE)
Preconditions:
CMS admin is authenticated
Target account status is PENDING
All required documents are VERIFIED
Expected Outcome: HTTP 200 — account transitions to APPROVED, welcome email sent

Name: Admin rejects — documents missing (DT Rule 2: Y/Y/N → REJECT)
Preconditions:
CMS admin is authenticated
Account status PENDING
Documents NOT uploaded
Expected Outcome: HTTP 400 — rejection reason required, status transitions to REJECTED

Name: Viewer role gets 403 — regardless of account/docs state (DT Rules 5–8)
Preconditions:
Viewer-role user authenticated
Target account PENDING

Name: State: PENDING → APPROVED (valid transition)
Preconditions:
Admin authenticated
Account PENDING
Docs verified

Name: State: REJECTED → APPROVED (invalid — must return 409)
Expected Outcome: HTTP 409 Conflict — cannot approve a rejected account

Name: EP valid: pending account with all conditions met → approved
Preconditions:
Admin authenticated
Account PENDING
Docs verified

Name: EP invalid: non-pending status cannot be approved
Preconditions:
Admin authenticated
Account is ACTIVE (not pending)
Expected Outcome: HTTP 409 — account not in approvable state

Name: Error guessing: concurrent approve + reject same account (race)
Expected Outcome: Exactly one succeeds; second returns 409 or is idempotent

Name: Error guessing: XSS in rejection_reason field
Preconditions:
Admin authenticated
Account PENDING
Docs missing
Expected Outcome: HTTP 400 or sanitized — no JS executed
